# PowerShell module Community.Zabbix.Agent: command reference

One page per command, the same text `Get-Help <command> -Full` shows; `Get-Help <command> -Online` opens the page. Concepts are in `Get-Help about_Community.Zabbix.Agent`.

| Command | Synopsis |
| --- | --- |
| [Start-ZbxActiveAgent](Start-ZbxActiveAgent.md) | Starts an active agent as a session: it asks its servers which items to collect, answers the built-in keys, and pushes agent data until stopped. |
| [Stop-ZbxActiveAgent](Stop-ZbxActiveAgent.md) | Stops an active agent session. |
| [Register-ZbxActiveAgentHandler](Register-ZbxActiveAgentHandler.md) | Registers a scriptblock that answers an item key on a running active agent session. |
| [Clear-ZbxActiveAgentLog](Clear-ZbxActiveAgentLog.md) | Empties the log buffer of a running active agent session. |
| [Get-ZbxActiveAgentLog](Get-ZbxActiveAgentLog.md) | Gets the recent log entries of a running active agent session. |
| [Get-ZbxActiveAgentStatus](Get-ZbxActiveAgentStatus.md) | Gets the running active agent sessions. |
| [New-ZbxAgentHandler](New-ZbxAgentHandler.md) | Builds a handler for an item key, to register on agent sessions. |
| [Register-ZbxAgentHandler](Register-ZbxAgentHandler.md) | Registers a scriptblock that answers an item key on a running agent session. |
| [Clear-ZbxAgentHost](Clear-ZbxAgentHost.md) | Deletes what an agent session provisioned on the server. |
| [Get-ZbxAgentHost](Get-ZbxAgentHost.md) | Gets the host an agent session created on the server, and which of its items the session answers. |
| [Initialize-ZbxAgentHost](Initialize-ZbxAgentHost.md) | Creates the host, interface and items an agent session answers, or reuses those that exist. |
| [Publish-ZbxAgentHost](Publish-ZbxAgentHost.md) | Adds an item to the session's host for every key the session now answers. |
| [Test-ZbxAgentItem](Test-ZbxAgentItem.md) | Answers an item key the way an agent session would, without a server. |
| [Export-ZbxAgentTemplate](Export-ZbxAgentTemplate.md) | Exports the host an agent session provisioned, with its interface and items. |
| [Start-ZbxPassiveAgent](Start-ZbxPassiveAgent.md) | Starts a passive agent as a session: a listener that answers the built-in keys to whichever server asks, until stopped. |
| [Stop-ZbxPassiveAgent](Stop-ZbxPassiveAgent.md) | Stops a passive agent session. |
| [Register-ZbxPassiveAgentHandler](Register-ZbxPassiveAgentHandler.md) | Registers a scriptblock that answers an item key on a running passive agent session. |
| [Clear-ZbxPassiveAgentLog](Clear-ZbxPassiveAgentLog.md) | Empties the log buffer of a running passive agent session. |
| [Get-ZbxPassiveAgentLog](Get-ZbxPassiveAgentLog.md) | Gets the recent log entries of a running passive agent session. |
| [Get-ZbxPassiveAgentStatus](Get-ZbxPassiveAgentStatus.md) | Gets the running passive agent sessions. |
